title: mini-crosslink-cost-coverage-scan-sep-2026
content:
Purpose: quick one-page spreadsheet-style scan to capture small gaps across teams that impact short-term SLO coverage and estimated incremental cost. Not a full audit — lightweight, prioritized for next 2 weeks.

Summary (top-line):
- Found 7 small coverage gaps (routing, fallback policy, APAC regional burst, observability knobs, embeddings quota alignment, dedicated pool tagging, canary time-window).
- Estimated incremental daily cost if unmitigated: ~$1,150/day.
- Quick recommended actions: 3 low-effort fixes (<= 1 day) to remove ~60% of burn and reduce customer impact.

Tracker table (rows = issues discovered during ad-hoc sweep):

Columns: Area | Short description | Owner | Coverage (low/med/high) | Estimated incremental cost/day | Quick fix ETA | Current blocker | Action/Notes

1) Routing fallback | Canary fallback not configured for small-model failover in EU-west | Marco Ruiz | medium | $120 | 2d | config matrix unclear | Add simple fallback mapping (INF-4132) + smoke test

2) Dedicated pool tags | Some customer-dedicated pools missing policy tags; autoscaler may skip | Tess Nguyen | low | $40 | 1d | tag schema mismatch | Run tagging script + add qa check in PR #5483

3) APAC burst cap | APAC region burst policy limited to 50 concurrent, observed spikes cause throttles | Priya Sethi | high | $480 | 3d | capacity request pending | Approve short-term burst increase, schedule capacity request with infra

4) Observability knobs | Route-level traces sampling too low for embeddings route -> blindspots | Ava Coleman | medium | $80 | 1d | tracing quota concern | Increase sampling to 5% for 72h and monitor costs

5) Embeddings quota alignment | Customer quota mismatches causing throttles during nightly batch | Marco Ruiz | low | $90 | 2d | unclear owner for quota config | Reconcile quotas; create single source spreadsheet row

6) Canary window | Canary rollout window overlaps maintenance window for Hosted API | Tess Nguyen | low | $60 | 1d | calendar sync gap | Shorten canary or shift maintenance; send ops calendar invite

7) Prefix cache warmup | New model variant not warming KV cache, latency spikes for first 2m | Priya Sethi | high | $320 | 4d | infra-side prewarm missing | Implement simple prefix-warm script in orchestration layer

----
Quick math: sum incremental cost/day = $1,190/day (rounded) — rough estimate based on spike frequency observed Aug-Sep 2026.
Impact tiering guidance:
- Immediate (<=48h): items 2,4,6 — low effort, medium effect (expected to remove ~420/day).
- Short-term (3–7d): items 1,5 — medium effort, reduces customer-facing throttles.
- Medium (7–14d): items 3,7 — higher impact, requires infra capacity or orchestration changes.

Open questions / stuff to tidy:
- Confirm APAC short-term capacity: who owns emergency credits for Sep-Oct? (pinged infra team, ticket INF-4201).
- Tracing cost: if sampling increased to 5% for 72h, estimate added cost ~ $70–100 — ok for now?
- Should we centralize per-route quick-scan into product-ops weekly checklist? (pro: faster detection; con: overhead).

Next steps (owners & short actions):
- Marco: implement fallback mapping and open PR for routing config (2d). Link: INF-4132.
- Tess: run tagging fix script & calendar change for canary (1d). Attach PR and CC ops.
- Ava: increase traces sampling to 5% for embeddings route, return cost snapshot (24h).
- Priya: draft capacity request for APAC burst increase and schedule infra sync (by Sep 17).
- Everyone: quick retro in Slack #ops-mini-scans on Sep 21 — what worked, what to add to weekly checklist.

Notes to self: this sheet is intentionally lightweight — avoid turning into full SRE runbook. If a gap looks systemic, spin up separate tracker.

Related artifacts: Confluence quick notes page (linked), Jira INF-4132 (routing fallback), runtime PR #5483 (tagging script).

Raw findings snapshot (copy of quick telemetry):
- 2026-09-12 03:20-03:28 UTC: APAC region error rate spike 5.2% (p95 latency + 340ms).
- 2026-09-13 14:10 UTC: New model rollout latency spike; KV cache cold for ~110s window.
- 2026-09-10 09:05 UTC: Observability traces dropped for ~12% of embeddings requests (sampling 0.2%).

Quick checklist for owner handoffs:
- Create the small tickets with clear acceptance criteria.
- Tag owners in tickets and add ops rotation on-call for short verification window.
- Close loop: report back to #platform-ops with before/after numbers.

TODO (short):
- [ ] Marco: PR for fallback mapping (due Sep 16)
- [ ] Tess: run tagging fix + update canary calendar (due Sep 16)
- [ ] Ava: run 72h trace sample test and post cost (due Sep 18)
- [ ] Priya: infra sync for APAC burst (meeting Sep 17)

Last updated notes: small edits after infra sync on Sep 20 — adjusted APAC cost estimate down to $480/day based on revised spike frequency.

If you copy this sheet into a longer-running tracker, please keep the header as-is so upstream tooling can pick up metadata (title/owner/date).

End of scan.
